walkthrough.title: A birthday, beautifully handled
walkthrough.caption: Eight chapters · Real product screens · A fictional guest
walkthrough.voice: Let's follow Alex's birthday enquiry through the latest FormBridge guided demo. The page shows whose turn it is, brings the current step into view, and keeps the next action at the bottom.

walkthrough.title: 01 · Send the guest enquiry
walkthrough.caption: Press Tab in the message box, then send the enquiry
walkthrough.voice: Start as Alex. Press Tab in the empty message box, or select Fill guest message. The suggestion includes the restaurant, date, time, guest count and special requests. Send the enquiry to the team.

walkthrough.title: The conversation becomes a brief
walkthrough.caption: Five booking details, saved with the conversation
walkthrough.voice: FormBridge extracts the five booking details and saves the enquiry in the separate demo inbox. The original message stays with the brief.

walkthrough.title: 02 · Change the plans
walkthrough.caption: Four guests become six. Seven becomes sometime after eight.
walkthrough.voice: Now Alex changes the plans. Fill the correction and update the enquiry. The restaurant and date stay in place, while the guest count and time preference change.

walkthrough.title: 03 · Reply as the host
walkthrough.caption: The exact time is still unresolved
walkthrough.voice: The demo switches to the host and shows Staff's turn. Suggest eight-thirty and add the staff reply. An offer still needs the guest's acceptance.

walkthrough.title: 04 · Let the guest accept
walkthrough.caption: Alex accepts 8:30 pm
walkthrough.voice: Switch back to Alex. Fill and send the acceptance. Only now can eight-thirty become the agreed time.

walkthrough.title: Check the answer against its source
walkthrough.caption: Open Time to inspect the supporting messages
walkthrough.voice: Open Time in the brief. Staff can inspect the offer and the acceptance, alongside earlier messages. The change history keeps the previous request visible.

walkthrough.title: 05 · Review the guest requests
walkthrough.caption: Choose which requests to keep
walkthrough.voice: Find guest requests. Read the quotations, then select the birthday, quiet table and dietary request. Staff still need to confirm dietary requirements with the guest and kitchen.

walkthrough.title: 06 · Approve and save the handoff
walkthrough.caption: A reviewed brief, an owner and a follow-up time
walkthrough.voice: Check the brief and fill the handoff note. Approve and save. The enquiry now has a reviewed request, an owner and a follow-up time for the team.

walkthrough.title: 07 · Let Alex check the details
walkthrough.caption: Private review. Staff notes stay private.
walkthrough.voice: Create the guest review link. Check the details as Alex, tick the confirmation box and send the review back. The guest view keeps staff notes and the full conversation private.

walkthrough.title: 08 · Prepare the provider handoff
walkthrough.caption: Clearly labelled simulated availability
walkthrough.voice: Return to the host. Check the simulated availability, review the returned times, then complete the simulated handoff. This demonstration does not contact a real reservation platform.

walkthrough.title: The complete enquiry, ready for handoff
walkthrough.caption: Try it: formbridge-nlp-at2.vercel.app/demo
walkthrough.voice: The tour is complete. The guest's changing plans, their reviewed requests and the next step are together in one enquiry. Open the guided demo to try the same workflow yourself.
